raw.rationale: AT13387 is a resorcinol-class HSP90 inhibitor whose single-agent PRISM activity is typically modest and not strongly lineage-selective, with the possible exception of HER2/ERBB2-amplified breast and some mutant-kinase-driven lung lines; most lineages have low prior probability of meeting the selective-kill criteria. Published HSP90 inhibitor screens show occasional selective sensitivity in breast, lung, and gastric contexts, but broad cytotoxicity and resistance mechanisms keep probabilities low across lineages.
